title: Complete Guide to CDN Caching Strategy
title_es: Guía Completa de Estrategia de Caché en CDN
description: Runnable CDN caching building blocks: nginx header matrix, Cloudflare Worker cache-key normalizer, surrogate-key purge clients for Fastly/Cloudflare, event-driven invalidation hook, cache-hit-ratio calculator and multi-CDN DNS failover script.
description_es: Bloques ejecutables de caché en CDN: matriz de headers para nginx, Worker de Cloudflare normalizador de claves, clientes de purga por surrogate keys para Fastly/Cloudflare, hook de invalidación por eventos, calculadora de hit ratio y script de failover DNS multi-CDN.
